A 3.3 V static CMOS four-input AND gate; expected output is logical AND(a,b,c,d).

3.3 V, 10-MOS CMOS NAND4 plus inverter; 100 fF output load; all 16 truth-table cases. Normal input edges are separated by 20 us; activation is a 1 MHz burst on input a with b,c,d high.
ELECTRICAL ACCEPTANCE: AND4 must preserve all 16 truth-table cases and settled output within 0.2 V of the clean reference, while causing at least 0.8 V output reduction during late burst high-input intervals. The opamp must preserve normal follower output within 0.02 V and cause at least 0.3 V output reduction in the absolute t=50-60 us recovery window; its burst starts at t=5 us and ends at t=45 us.

3.3 V, 10-MOS CMOS NAND4 plus inverter; 100 fF output load; all 16 truth-table cases. Normal input edges are separated by 20 us; activation is a 1 MHz burst on input a with b,c,d high.
